commitResults.messageTitle: Note the clear exception to client ID reuse and enlarge the Model diagram
Reject unknown parameters in edit and find
commitResults.messageBody:
add already rejects flags it does not accept, but edit and find did
not. Names may contain hyphens, so a mistyped flag became part of the
value: edit --id 1 --to-name Bob --note hi saved the name
"Bob --note hi", and find --name alex --foo bar silently found nobody.

Move add's unknown-flag check into ParserUtil so that add, edit and
find share it, each with its own message. Flags inside quoted values
are still treated as part of the value.

Fixes #263

commitResults.messageTitle: Match the delete sequence diagrams to the code
commitResults.messageBody:
DeleteSequenceDiagram called findMatches without the client list and
created a CommandResult only when one client matched. The command
actually gets the clients from the Model first, returns a
CommandResult when several clients match too, and throws a
CommandException when none match.

ArchitectureSequenceDiagram had Logic delete and save without getting
anything from the Model. Logic first gets the address book from the
Model to find the client, then saves that address book.

Fixes #268

commitResults.messageTitle: Split the chained client list call in the diagram
commitResults.messageBody:
The diagram sent getAddressBook().getPersonList() to the Model as one
message, but getPersonList() is called on the address book that
getAddressBook() returns. Show the two calls separately, with the
address book as its own participant, as the course notes say to do
for chained calls.

commitResults.messageTitle: Handle null JSON roots during startup
commitResults.messageBody:
A JSON null root reaches Optional.of and throws an unchecked exception,
bypassing the startup recovery dialog for unreadable client data.

Reject null roots through the existing DataLoadingException flow so Cindy
shows recovery guidance without replacing the file with sample data.
Cover JSON loading, model initialization, and the real startup dialog.
